summary.en: The source document parks at the left, still being read, while findings are dealt one by one on the right, each tied to its evidence line.
summary.zh: 来源文档退到左边只露一截、还在慢慢往下读，右边一条条发出结论药丸，每条都连回文档里划出的依据句。

fits: A narrated passage that gives conclusions one at a time and must keep their source in view: analysis results, review findings, reasons for a recommendation.
notFor: More than three findings (a caption needs about 1.2 s to be read); conclusions without a source line; a loud beat (the scene has no peak, its life is the slow scroll).

overlaps.note: page cards step on the word and a noun holds; doc-findings keeps one source page and deals findings tied to its lines
a list rises in place; doc-findings deals one item per narrated sentence

intent.en: Give conclusions one at a time without losing their source: the document stays on screen and is still being read, and every finding is visibly pulled out of one of its lines.
intent.zh: 一条条给出结论又不丢出处：文档留在画面里、还在被读，每条结论都看得出是从它的某一行里长出来的。

content.en: A source document (10–40 lines; 1–3 real evidence lines, en ≤ 64 chars, zh ≤ 28) and 2–3 findings, each a name (en ≤ 18, zh ≤ 7), an optional value and a caption (en ≤ 40, zh ≤ 16), paced to one narrated sentence each.
content.zh: 一份来源文档（10–40 行，其中 1–3 行是真实证据句，英文 ≤ 64 字符，中文 ≤ 28 字）和 2–3 条结论，每条一个名称（英文 ≤ 18，中文 ≤ 7）、可选数值和一句说明（英文 ≤ 40，中文 ≤ 16），每条配一句旁白的时间。

fits.zh: 旁白一条条给出结论、又必须让出处一直在画面里的段落：分析结果、审阅意见、推荐理由。

notFor.zh: 超过三条结论（每句说明要约 1.2 秒才读得完）；没有出处行的结论；响亮的一拍（这一屏没有峰值，靠缓慢滚动维持生气）。

pairs.note: a faster cut through several pages when the findings come from many sources

en: Three findings at most; a fourth leaves no time for its caption to be read.
The document must be longer than the whole scroll, or the page scrolls into blank space.
Re-time the deal to the real captions; caption length sets how fast the word-by-word darkening reads.
zh: 最多三条；第四条没时间读完说明。
文档要比整段滚动行程长，否则末段滚出空白。
换真实文案后按句长重排发牌时间；说明的长短决定逐词加深读起来的快慢。

upstream.name: 文档驻留发牌
upstream.summary: 文档不淡出而是向左滑出只露约 35% 宽并微缩到 0.92，右侧按旁白节奏慢速发牌三张白底描边药丸（outBack 弹入），每张落定后其下方字幕逐词加深、下一张到来前整句淡出，左侧文档全程极缓慢自动滚动保持"正在被读"
upstream.use: 旁白驱动的"分析结论逐条给出"段落；文档理解、推荐理由、审阅意见类产品的核心说明镜头
upstream.energy: 低（慢发牌节奏，全片无峰值；靠自动滚动维持活性）
